scope: Theorem 2 (Localization of conjugated product projections) of the manuscript “Product-projection localization and the QAC0 parity lower bound” (preprints/Product-projection-localization-and-the-QAC0-parity-lower-bound-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 274 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 12393c9f997aa808), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 5. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix a nonnegative integer d and real numbers 0 ≤ s < t. For all sufficiently large N, every U ∈ Ud(N) and every pair of counts M, D on HN satisfy ⃦ ⃦ ⃦[M ≥ Nt ] U[D = 0]U† [M = 0] ⃦ ⃦ ⃦ ≤ exp(−Ns ). (2.4) The sufficient lower bound on N depends only on d, s, t, not on the circuit, the counted subsets, or their reference vectors.
